in_marathi.name: Ajmol
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajmol हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajmol is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘mol’ meaning ‘joy’. This name signifies the joy that comes from not being bound by worldly desires or material possessions. It is a name for a boy who embodies happiness and freedom from earthly attachments.
